<function name="LanguageChanged" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Callback function for when the client's language changes. Called by the engine.</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<file line="534-L544">lua/menu/mainmenu.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="lang" type="string">The new language code.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the new language code whenever the language changes.</description>
	<code>
local OldLanguageChanged = LanguageChanged
function LanguageChanged( lang )
	print( "New language: " .. lang )
	OldLanguageChanged( lang )
end
	</code>
	<output>New language: en</output>

</example>
